title: UltraFlash: Accelerating Megapixel Visual Synthesis
title_zh: UltraFlash：加速兆像素级视觉合成

paragraphs.en: Megapixel visual synthesis with latent diffusion models requires operating far beyond the resolution at which these models are trained. Cascade refinement is the most successful approach to handling this problem: it upgrades a base image at a regular resolution to the target resolution via multiple cascade upsampling steps, each involving a resolution upgrade traversed through pixel space and a denoising-based refinement in latent space. Although denoising is often treated as the main cost, we identify an underexplored source of overhead: repeatedly moving representations through the VAE. We refer to these steps as pixel-space transitions : intermediate latents are decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement, while final latents are decoded patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress artifacts. We present UltraFlash , which shifts the focus of acceleration from denoising alone to the VAE transitions around it. Its first component, Latent Hyperloop , replaces the intermediate RGB round trip with a learned latent-space shortcut that approximates the same transformation while avoiding repeated VAE calls for decoding and encoding. Its second component, Sparse Patch-based Decoding , makes final reconstruction efficient by tracing patch seams to inconsistent GroupNorm statistics and reusing cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse VAE decoding with much smaller overlap. Integrated into the current state-of-the-art baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K generation latency by ∼ \sim 2 × \times while improving image quality, demonstrating that transition-level optimization can advance both efficiency and fidelity. More broadly, these transition costs recur across megapixel synthesis pipelines, suggesting that optimizing pixel-space transitions is an effective route to fast, high-fidelity visual synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 基于潜在扩散模型的百万像素级视觉合成需要在远超这些模型训练分辨率的条件下运行。 级联细化是解决这一问题最成功的方法：它通过多个级联上采样步骤将规则分辨率的基础图像提升到目标分辨率，每一步都包含一次穿越像素空间的分辨率提升和一次在潜在空间中基于去噪的细化。 尽管去噪通常被视为主要开销，我们发现了另一处未被充分探索的开销来源：反复在 VAE 中搬运表示。 我们将这些步骤称为像素空间转换：中间潜在表示被解码为 RGB、缩放并重新编码后再进行细化，而最终潜在表示则以密集重叠的方式逐块解码以抑制伪影。 我们提出 UltraFlash，它将加速的重点从单纯去噪转移到围绕去噪的 VAE 转换上。 其第一个组件 Latent Hyperloop 用一个学习到的潜在空间捷径取代中间的 RGB 往返过程，该捷径在避免反复调用 VAE 进行解码和编码的同时，逼近相同的变换。 其第二个组件 Sparse Patch-based Decoding 通过追踪块接缝处不一致的 GroupNorm 统计量并跨块复用缓存的统计量，使最终重建变得高效，从而实现重叠大幅减小的稀疏 VAE 解码。 集成到当前最先进的基线中后，UltraFlash 将 4K 生成延迟降低约 2 倍，同时提升了图像质量，表明转换级别的优化能够同时推进效率与保真度。 更广泛地说，这些转换开销在各类百万像素级合成流水线中反复出现，表明优化像素空间转换是实现快速、高保真视觉合成的一条有效途径。

paragraphs.en: Latent diffusion models have greatly advanced visual synthesis, but their native training resolution remains a practical boundary. Although applications increasingly require 2K, 4K, and larger outputs, models trained around 512 × 512 512\times 512 or 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 often produce repeated objects, distorted layouts, or unstable textures when directly evaluated on larger canvases. Fine-tuning on high-resolution data is a natural remedy, but it is difficult to scale: diverse megapixel-scale datasets are limited, training at such resolutions is expensive, and the adapted model often becomes specialized to a fixed target resolution ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Existing alternatives therefore rely on inference-time strategies that reuse pretrained models. Direct extrapolation methods modify inference on enlarged latents, but can suffer from memory cost and structural instability at extreme resolutions. Cascade refinement methods instead generate at a reliable native resolution and progressively construct larger images through refinement stages ( Du et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Vontobel et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Representative systems differ in how they refine enlarged latents: DemoFusion uses progressive patch-based refinement, FouriScale and FreeScale modify frequency or scale behavior, HiWave uses structure-preserving inversion, and PixelRush ( Lai et al., 2026 ) accelerates the cascade with one-step diffusion refinement. Among these, PixelRush currently provides the strongest speed–quality trade-off, making it the most relevant stress test for remaining non-denoising overhead. We therefore use PixelRush as the main instantiation of UltraFlash, while targeting VAE-heavy pixel-space transitions that are shared by the broader cascade family.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在扩散模型极大地推动了视觉合成的发展，但其原生训练分辨率仍然是一个实际的边界。 尽管应用日益需要 2K、4K 甚至更大的输出，但围绕 512 × 512 512\times 512 或 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 训练的模型在更大的画布上直接评估时，往往会产生重复的物体、扭曲的布局或不稳定的纹理。 在高分辨率数据上进行微调是一种自然的补救方法，但难以规模化：多样的兆像素级数据集很有限，在此类分辨率下训练成本高昂，且适配后的模型往往只能专用于某一固定的目标分辨率 ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) 。 因此，现有的替代方案依赖于复用预训练模型的推理时策略。 直接外推方法会修改在放大的潜在表示上的推理过程，但在极端分辨率下可能面临内存开销和结构不稳定的问题。 级联细化方法则选择在可靠的原生分辨率下生成，并通过多个细化阶段逐步构建更大的图像 ( Du et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Vontobel et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) 。 各代表性系统在细化放大的潜在表示的方式上有所不同：DemoFusion 采用渐进式的基于图块的细化，FouriScale 和 FreeScale 修改频率或尺度行为，HiWave 使用保结构反演，而 PixelRush ( Lai et al., 2026 ) 则通过单步扩散细化加速级联过程。 在这些方法中，PixelRush 目前提供了最强的速度-质量权衡，使其成为对剩余非去噪开销进行压力测试的最相关选择。 因此，我们使用 PixelRush 作为 UltraFlash 的主要实例化对象，同时针对更广泛的级联家族所共有的高开销 VAE 像素空间转换进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Most acceleration efforts for megapixel synthesis focus on denoising or refinement. This is natural, since diffusion sampling is expensive and larger spatial sizes increase the cost of each denoising operation. However, we find that this view is incomplete. Modern cascade pipelines also spend substantial time repeatedly moving representations through the VAE. We call these operations pixel-space transitions : steps where a latent representation is converted to RGB or where RGB is converted back to a latent representation. These transitions appear in two places. First, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement. Second, the final latent must be decoded to RGB, but at megapixel scale this is typically done patch by patch with dense overlap to suppress artifacts. As a result, a significant fraction of runtime is spent not on denoising itself, but on VAE-heavy transitions around denoising.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数针对兆像素级合成的加速工作都聚焦于去噪或精修。 这很自然，因为扩散采样开销高昂，而更大的空间尺寸会增加每次去噪操作的成本。 然而，我们发现这种看法并不完整。 现代级联流水线还会花费大量时间，反复在 VAE 中搬运表征。 我们将这些操作称为像素空间转换：即把潜在表征转换为 RGB，或把 RGB 转换回潜在表征的步骤。 这些转换出现在两个地方。 其一，中间潜在表征通常会在精修前被解码为 RGB、缩放后再重新编码。 其二，最终的潜在表征必须解码为 RGB，但在兆像素尺度下，这通常需要以高密度重叠的方式逐块进行，以抑制伪影。 结果是，相当大一部分运行时间并非花在去噪本身，而是花在围绕去噪的重度 VAE 转换上。

paragraphs.en: This observation exposes an underexplored source of overhead. The two transitions have different roles and therefore require different solutions. The intermediate RGB round trip is avoidable: it is used as a convenient way to transform a latent before refinement, but it need not be performed through pixels. The final transition is unavoidable because the output image must be RGB, but its dense patch implementation is inefficient. Thus, the design goal is to replace the avoidable intermediate VAE round trip and make the final VAE decoding sparse without introducing seams.

sents.zh: 集成到当前最先进的级联基线（Lai et al., 2026）中后，UltraFlash 将 4K 生成延迟降低了 2 × 2\times 倍，同时提升了图像质量。

sents.en: This result shows that VAE transitions remain a substantial optimization spot even in highly optimized megapixel synthesis systems.
sents.zh: 这一结果表明，即使在高 度优化的百万像素级合成系统中，VAE 转换仍然是重要的优化点。

sents.en: More broadly, RGB round trips and dense patch-wise VAE decoding appear across cascade pipelines, suggesting that optimizing pixel-space transitions is an effective route to faster, high-fidelity visual synthesis.
sents.zh: 更广泛地说，RGB 往返转换和密集的分块 VAE 解码普遍存在于各种级联流水线中，这表明优化像素空间转换是实现更快、高保真视觉合成的有效途径。

paragraphs.en: We identify repeated VAE-heavy pixel-space transitions as an underexplored source of overhead in megapixel visual synthesis, beyond denoising and refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将反复出现的重度依赖 VAE 的像素空间转换视为兆像素级视觉合成中一种未被充分研究开销来源，其影响超出了去噪与细化之外。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Latent Hyperloop , a learned latent-space shortcut that replaces the intermediate decode–resize–encode round trip while avoiding repeated VAE decoding and encoding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Latent Hyperloop，这是一种学习得到的潜空间捷径，用以替代中间的解码–缩放–编码往返过程，同时避免重复的 VAE 解码与编码。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Sparse Patch-based Decoding , which enables sparse VAE decoding by sharing cached normalization statistics across independently decoded patches.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了稀疏补丁解码（Sparse Patch-based Decoding），它通过在独立解码的补丁之间共享缓存的归一化统计信息，实现稀疏 VAE 解码。

paragraphs.en: Megapixel Visual Synthesis. Scaling diffusion models beyond their native training resolution has been explored through several routes. One route trains or adapts models for native high-resolution generation, such as SANA, HunyuanImage, and other dedicated 2K/4K generators ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Team, 2025 ) . These methods can achieve strong quality, but they require high-resolution data, model adaptation, or dedicated training. A second route directly extrapolates pretrained models to larger canvases through inference-time modifications, such as convolutional dilation ( He et al., 2023 ) , frequency or scale fusion ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , flow-aligned guidance ( Bu et al., 2025 ) , or positional extrapolation for FLUX-based models ( Issachar et al., 2025 ) . These methods avoid retraining, but can suffer from memory cost, structural instability, or unnatural textures at extreme resolutions ( Lin et al., 2024b ) . A third route uses cascade or region-based refinement, synthesizing native-resolution windows and merging them into a larger image through average blending ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ) , DDIM inversion ( Vontobel et al., 2025 ) , or few-step refinement ( Lai et al., 2026 ) . This cascade line has progressed from multi-step patch refinement in DemoFusion to structure-preserving inversion in HiWave, and most recently to PixelRush, which uses one-step Turbo refinement to deliver the strongest speed–quality trade-off among cascade methods.
paragraphs.zh: 兆像素级视觉合成。 将扩散模型扩展到其原生训练分辨率之外，已经通过若干途径得到探索。 一种途径是训练或适配模型以实现原生高分辨率生成，例如 SANA、HunyuanImage 以及其他专用的 2K/4K 生成器（Xie 等，2025；Team，2025）。 这些方法能够达到很高的质量，但它们需要高分辨率数据、模型适配或专门训练。 第二种途径是通过推理时的修改，将预训练模型直接外推到更大的画布上，例如卷积膨胀（He 等，2023）、频率或尺度融合（Huang 等，2024）、流对齐引导（Bu 等，2025），或针对基于 FLUX 的模型的位置外推（Issachar 等，2025）。 这些方法无需重新训练，但在极端分辨率下可能出现显存开销大、结构不稳定或纹理不自然等问题（Lin 等，2024b）。 第三种途径使用级联或基于区域的细化，先生成原生分辨率的窗口，再通过平均融合（Bar-Tal 等，2023；Du 等，2024）、DDIM 反演（Vontobel 等，2025）或少步细化（Lai 等，2026）将它们合并成更大的图像。 这条级联技术路线从 DemoFusion 的多步图块细化，发展到 HiWave 的保持结构的反演，最近又发展到 PixelRush——它使用一步 Turbo 细化，在级联方法中提供了最佳的速度—质量权衡。

paragraphs.en: Our work focuses on the cascade setting because it reuses pretrained models in their reliable operating regime while supporting megapixel outputs. We use PixelRush as the main experimental instantiation because it is already optimized for denoising speed; improving it therefore tests whether VAE transition overhead remains a meaningful bottleneck after the dominant sampling cost has been compressed. paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作聚焦于级联设置，因为它在可靠的工作区间内复用预训练模型，同时支持兆像素级的输出。 我们选择 PixelRush 作为主要的实验实例，因为它已经针对去噪速度进行了优化；因此，对它的改进可以检验：在主要的采样成本被压缩之后，VAE 转换开销是否仍然是一个有意义的瓶颈。 UltraFlash 并未引入另一种精修策略，而是围绕精修过程优化 VAE 密集的转换环节：包括为准备精修输入而进行的中间 RGB 往返转换，以及用于重建输出图像的最终分块 VAE 解码。

paragraphs.en: Pixel-Space Transitions. Latent diffusion models use a VAE to move between compressed latents and RGB images ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) . In megapixel synthesis, this creates two transition costs. First, intermediate latents are often decoded to RGB, resized, and re-encoded before refinement. This route is stable and avoids artifacts from naive latent manipulation ( Qiu et al., 2025 ; Vontobel et al., 2025 ) , but requires an expensive decode–encode round trip. Because the VAE encoder is nonlinear, ordinary latent interpolation is not that round trip. FAM Diffusion ( Yang et al., 2025 ) compensates with learned frequency and attention modulation over the whole latent, and it changes the denoiser. Latent Hyperloop is a patch-wise shortcut for the same decode–resize–encode transformation and leaves the denoiser unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 像素空间转换。 潜在扩散模型使用 VAE 在压缩的潜在表示与 RGB 图像之间转换（Rombach et al., 2022）。 在兆像素级图像合成中，这会带来两次转换开销。 首先，中间潜在表示通常需要先解码为 RGB，再进行缩放和重新编码，然后才能进行细化。 这条路径是稳定的，能够避免对潜在表示进行朴素操作所引发的伪影（Qiu et al., 2025；Vontobel et al., 2025），但需要付出昂贵的解码-编码往返开销。 由于 VAE 编码器是非线性的，普通的潜在插值并不等同于那次往返。 FAM Diffusion（Yang et al., 2025）通过对整个潜在表示施加可学习的频率与注意力调制来进行补偿，并且它会改变去噪器。 Latent Hyperloop 则是针对同样解码-缩放-编码变换的一种逐块捷径，并且不改变去噪器。

paragraphs.en: Second, the final latent must be decoded to RGB. Since full-image VAE decoding is memory-intensive at megapixel scale, pipelines decode overlapping patches and blend them. Large overlaps hide seams but repeat computation; small overlaps reveal boundary artifacts. We identify inconsistent GroupNorm statistics ( Wu and He, 2018 ) across patches as a key cause, and use Sparse Patch-based Decoding to share cached statistics across patches, enabling sparse reconstruction with much smaller overlap.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，最终的潜变量必须被解码为 RGB。 由于在全图像上进行 VAE 解码在兆像素级别会消耗大量内存，管线会对重叠的图块进行解码并将其融合。 较大的重叠可以隐藏拼接缝隙但会重复计算；较小的重叠则会暴露边界伪影。 我们发现各图块之间不一致的 GroupNorm 统计量（Wu and He, 2018）是一个关键原因，并使用基于图块的稀疏解码来在各图块间共享缓存的统计量，从而以小得多的重叠实现稀疏重建。

paragraphs.en: Super-Resolution. Super-resolution methods reconstruct high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Dong et al., 2014 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) . Diffusion-based super-resolution methods ( Li et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) further improve perceptual quality, but are typically trained for restoration. Megapixel visual synthesis differs from restoration: the input is a generated intermediate representation, and the goal is coherent visual synthesis rather than recovering a unique high-resolution target ( Lai et al., 2026 ) . Thus, although super-resolution and megapixel synthesis both involve scale expansion, they address different problem settings and require different evaluation criteria.

Megapixel synthesis commonly starts from the model’s native resolution and progressively enlarges the image through cascade refinement ( Du et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Vontobel et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) . Although methods differ in refinement details, each stage typically initializes a larger latent by routing the current latent through RGB.

Since full-image VAE decoding is memory-intensive at megapixel scale, practical systems decode overlapping patches and stitch them together, where dense overlap suppresses seams but repeats computation. paragraphs.en: We present UltraFlash , which shifts acceleration from denoising alone to the VAE-heavy pixel-space transitions that surround it. paragraphs.en: Context-Expanded Patching. To make ℋ ϕ \mathcal{H}_{\phi} general and work at every cascade step regardless of input resolution, we design it to process patch-by-patch, using fixed resolutions for the input and output latent patches. Since the follow-up refinement step also processes overlapping patches, a convenient design is to use the same patch configuration in these two steps: the output patches of ℋ ϕ \mathcal{H}_{\phi} should have the same resolution and location as the ones used in the refinement. With that configuration, the patches produced by ℋ ϕ \mathcal{H}_{\phi} can be sent for processing at the refinement step directly, skipping the operation to collect and aggregate them to form the full latent output 𝐳 ¯ 0 4 ​ r \bar{\mathbf{z}}_{0}^{4r} .

paragraphs.en: Lightweight Spatial Prior. Latent Hyperloop ℋ ϕ \mathcal{H}_{\phi} needs to double the resolution of the input latent 𝐳 0 r \mathbf{z}_{0}^{r} . While we could use any super-resolution backbone with an adjusted number of input/output channels and train on paired data, this would require the model to learn spatial upsampling behavior in the latent space from scratch. Instead, we reuse the first decoding block of the VAE decoder, denoted as 𝒟 ( 1 ) \mathcal{D}^{(1)} , which already implements latent upsampling and has been well trained on massive data. This pretrained block serves as a spatial prior , effectively guiding ℋ ϕ \mathcal{H}_{\phi} ’s spatial upsampling operation. However, this block often produces feature maps with a different number of channels and unaligned geometry compared to the desired output 𝐳 0 4 ​ r \mathbf{z}_{0}^{4r} . Hence, we need a projection head to adjust the number of channels and refine the geometry of the produced latent output.

paragraphs.en: Attention Alignment ( ℒ a ​ t ​ t ​ e ​ n \mathcal{L}_{atten} ). Reconstruction loss alone is insufficient. Since the loss is operated directly on the latent manifold, a small numerical distance error does not necessarily guarantee that two latents are perceptually or semantically equivalent. Furthermore, by treating each latent pixel independently, a simple reconstruction objective often tolerates subtle misalignments. Both lead to a loss of fine-grained structure in the decoded image. In principle, a GAN loss could help, but it often makes optimization substantially more sensitive to hyperparameters and empirically less stable.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力对齐（\mathcal{L}_{atten}）。 仅靠重建损失是不够的。 由于该损失直接作用于潜在流形上，数值上很小的距离误差并不一定能保证两个潜在表示在感知或语义上是等价的。 此外，若将每个潜在像素独立处理，简单的重建目标往往会容忍细微的错位。 这两者都会导致解码图像中细粒度结构的丢失。 原则上，GAN 损失可以有所帮助，但它往往使优化对超参数明显更加敏感，且从经验上看稳定性也更差。

sents.en: Furthermore, by treating each latent pixel independently, a simple reconstruction objective often tolerates subtle misalignments.

paragraphs.en: While Latent Hyperloop removes avoidable intermediate RGB round trips, the final pixel-space transition is unavoidable: after refinement, the latent 𝐳 0 R \mathbf{z}_{0}^{R} must be decoded into RGB. At megapixel scale, however, full-latent VAE decoding is often memory-prohibitive, so practical synthesis pipelines decode the latent patch by patch and blend overlapping regions ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Vontobel et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) . Dense overlap helps suppress seams, but it also repeats VAE computation over many regions. A natural acceleration is to reduce the overlap, but naive sparse decoding introduces visible boundary artifacts, including color shifts, brightness inconsistencies, and texture discontinuities at patch boundaries, as shown in Fig. 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 Latent Hyperloop 去除了可避免的中间 RGB 往返转换，但最终的像素空间转换仍不可避免：在细化之后，潜在表示 𝐳 0 R \mathbf{z}_{0}^{R} 必须被解码为 RGB。 然而在兆像素尺度下，对整个潜在表示进行 VAE 解码往往受内存限制而不可行，因此实用的合成管线会逐块解码潜在表示并对重叠区域进行混合（Bar-Tal et al., 2023；Du et al., 2024；Vontobel et al., 2025；Lai et al., 2026）。 大量重叠有助于抑制接缝，但也会在许多区域上重复执行 VAE 计算。 一种自然的加速方法是减小重叠量，但朴素的稀疏解码会引入明显的边界伪影，包括块边界处的颜色偏移、亮度不一致和纹理不连续，如图 3 所示。

paragraphs.en: Why Sparse Decoding Fails. We trace the root cause of sparse-decoding artifacts to the GroupNorm (GN) layers in the VAE decoder. GroupNorm ( Wu and He, 2018 ) normalizes activations within each group of channels using statistics computed from the current input.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么稀疏解码会失败。 我们将稀疏解码伪影的根本原因追溯到 VAE 解码器中的 GroupNorm（GN）层。 GroupNorm（Wu and He, 2018）使用根据当前输入计算得到的统计量，对每组通道内的激活进行归一化。

paragraphs.en: Shared GN Statistics. Our solution is simple and requires no training. We compute a set of reference GroupNorm statistics once, then reuse them for all patches during decoding. First, we decode a set of reference patches { P ref ( i ) } i = 1 N ref \{P_{\mathrm{ref}}^{(i)}\}_{i=1}^{N_{\mathrm{ref}}} (utilizing the four corner patches of the latent) through the VAE decoder, recording the GroupNorm statistics ( μ l ref , σ l ref ) (\mu_{l}^{\mathrm{ref}},\sigma_{l}^{\mathrm{ref}}) at every layer l l . The cached statistics are 𝒞 = { ( μ l ref , σ l ref ) } l = 1 L \mathcal{C}=\{(\mu_{l}^{\mathrm{ref}},\sigma_{l}^{\mathrm{ref}})\}_{l=1}^{L} , where L L is the number of GroupNorm layers in the VAE decoder. Second, when decoding each patch P ( j ) P^{(j)} , we replace the per-patch GroupNorm computation with the cached reference statistics. This ensures that identical latent values always produce identical pixel values, regardless of which patch they belong to. The overlapping regions now agree perfectly, and simple blending, or even direct stitching, produces seamless results.
paragraphs.zh: 共享的 GroupNorm 统计量。 我们的解决方案简单且无需训练。 我们只需计算一次一组参考 GroupNorm 统计量，然后在解码期间对所有图块复用它们。 首先，我们通过 VAE 解码器解码一组参考图块 { P ref ( i ) } i = 1 N ref \{P_{\mathrm{ref}}^{(i)}\}_{i=1}^{N_{\mathrm{ref}}} （利用潜变量的四个角部图块），并在每一层 l l 记录 GroupNorm 统计量 ( μ l ref , σ l ref ) (\mu_{l}^{\mathrm{ref}},\sigma_{l}^{\mathrm{ref}}) 。 缓存的统计量为 𝒞 = { ( μ l ref , σ l ref ) } l = 1 L \mathcal{C}=\{(\mu_{l}^{\mathrm{ref}},\sigma_{l}^{\mathrm{ref}})\}_{l=1}^{L} ，其中 L L 是 VAE 解码器中 GroupNorm 层的数量。 其次，在解码每个图块 P ( j ) P^{(j)} 时，我们用缓存的参考统计量替代逐图块的 GroupNorm 计算。 这确保了相同的潜变量值总是产生相同的像素值，而不管它们属于哪个图块。 这样重叠区域现在完全一致，简单的融合甚至直接拼接都能产生无缝的结果。

paragraphs.en: Enabling Smaller Overlap. A key benefit of Sparse Patch-based Decoding is that it enables the use of much smaller overlaps during patch-wise VAE decoding. In standard cascade and patch-based synthesis pipelines ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Vontobel et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) , large overlaps (e.g., 25%) are often needed to mask patch-boundary inconsistencies through blending. With cached GroupNorm statistics, the overlap can be reduced by up to 8 × \times in our main setting while preserving visual continuity, since it no longer needs to hide per-patch normalization mismatch. This directly translates to fewer total patches and faster decoding:

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Data and Metrics. Following prior protocols ( Du et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ) , we evaluate on 1000 prompts sampled from LAION-Aesthetics ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ; Schuhmann, 2022 ) and report Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , crop-based FID (FID c ), Inception Score (IS) ( Salimans et al., 2016 ) , and wall-clock inference time. paragraphs.en: Baselines. Our main comparison focuses on SDXL-based cascade methods, including FouriScale ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , DemoFusion ( Du et al., 2024 ) , FreeScale ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) , and the fast cascade baseline PixelRush ( Lai et al., 2026 ) . This setting provides a direct comparison because these methods share a similar base-model regime and target high-resolution extrapolation from pretrained native-resolution generators. We use PixelRush as the representative fast cascade pipeline because it offers the strongest speed–quality trade-off among prior cascade methods. Unlike FouriScale, DemoFusion, and FreeScale, which rely on multi-step SDXL refinement, PixelRush uses one-step Turbo refinement for rapid generation. We denote configurations by the refiner used in the cascade: -SD uses SD-Turbo, while -XL uses SDXL-Turbo ( Sauer et al., 2024 ) . Unless otherwise specified, both configurations follow the same base-generation protocol. Finally, UltraFlash denotes the PixelRush fast cascade equipped with our Latent Hyperloop and Sparse Patch-based Decoding.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that adding our transition operators to the fast cascade improves both efficiency and fidelity. At 2K, the transition overhead is relatively small because the cascade contains fewer high-resolution patches, yet the gains remain consistent: UltraFlash-SD reduces runtime from 3.17s to 2.78s while improving FID from 52.56 to 50.02, and UltraFlash-XL achieves the best 2K FID of 49.86. The benefit becomes more pronounced at 4K, where transition costs compound across cascade stages and final VAE decoding. UltraFlash-SD reduces latency from 16.37s to 8.04s relative to the corresponding PixelRush-SD setting, while improving FID from 56.50 to 52.38. The XL configuration shows the same trend, reducing latency from 17.11s to 9.61s and improving FID from 54.28 to 51.32. These results indicate that replacing the intermediate RGB round trip with Latent Hyperloop and accelerating final RGB decoding with Sparse Patch-based Decoding removes transition overhead without sacrificing visual quality. Detailed ablations of both components are provided in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: To position our cascade pipeline in the broader 4K generation landscape, Table 2 (a) compares against two representative non-cascade routes. SANA-4K ( Xie et al., 2025 ) directly targets native 4K generation with a compact high-resolution model design, so it serves as a speed-oriented native-generation baseline. DyPE-FLUX ( Issachar et al., 2025 ) extrapolates a strong FLUX ( Labs, 2024 ) backbone to 4K and serves as a quality-oriented direct-inference baseline. Because these methods differ in backbone, training data, and inference assumptions, we treat this as a contextual comparison. UltraFlash-SD outperforms both methods in FID and particularly in latency, suggesting that a fast cascade pipeline with optimized pixel-space transitions can remain highly competitive with native or direct 4K approaches. We exclude super-resolution post-processing baselines from this comparison since they address a different restoration-style setting and have been shown to underperform cascade generation ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: We presented UltraFlash, a transition-efficient method for megapixel visual synthesis. Instead of only accelerating denoising, UltraFlash targets VAE-heavy pixel-space transitions in cascade pipelines. Latent Hyperloop replaces the intermediate decode–resize–encode round trip with a learned latent shortcut, while Sparse Patch-based Decoding accelerates final RGB reconstruction by sharing cached GroupNorm statistics across patches. Integrated into a state-of-the-art cascade baseline, UltraFlash reduces 4K latency by 2 × 2\times while improving image quality, showing that pixel-space transitions are an effective target for improving the speed–quality trade-off of megapixel synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 UltraFlash，一种面向百万像素级视觉合成的过渡高效方法。 UltraFlash 不仅仅加速去噪过程，而是针对级联管线中依赖 VAE 的像素空间过渡。 Latent Hyperloop 用一个学习到的潜空间捷径取代了中间的解码—缩放—编码往返过程，而 Sparse Patch-based Decoding 通过在图像块之间共享缓存的 GroupNorm 统计量来加速最终的 RGB 重建。 集成到最先进的级联基线中后，UltraFlash 将 4K 延迟降低了 2 × 2\times，同时提升了图像质量，表明像素空间过渡是改善百万像素级合成速度—质量权衡的有效目标。

paragraphs.en: We adopt a SwinIR-based architecture for the Latent Hyperloop (LH) and incorporate structural priors from the VAE decoder to guide the learned upsampling. With SDXL-Turbo refiner, LH accepts latent patch inputs with resolution 80 × 80 80\times 80 , i.e., a 64 × 64 64\times 64 source crop expanded by p = 8 p=8 context pixels on each side (input side length s + 2 ​ p s+2p with s = 64 s=64 ), to generate upsampled latent patches with resolution 128 × 128 128\times 128 . paragraphs.en: Overview. When decoding a high-resolution latent (spatial dimensions ≥ 512 \geq 512 ), a single-pass VAE decode causes out-of-memory errors. The standard solution is patch-wise decoding with overlapping regions. Large overlaps produce seamless results but are slow. Our Sparse VAE Decoding enables small overlaps by ensuring consistent GroupNorm statistics across all patches.
paragraphs.zh: 概述。 在解码高分辨率隐变量（空间维度 ≥ 512）时，单次通用的 VAE 解码会导致内存溢出错误。 标准的解决方案是使用带重叠区域的分块解码。 较大的重叠可以产生无缝的结果，但速度很慢。 我们的稀疏 VAE 解码通过确保所有分块之间一致的 GroupNorm 统计量，实现了小重叠的解码。

paragraphs.en: Why Each Component Matters. Fig. A1 a reveals why both components are necessary. First, we observe that a naive implementation of the Latent Hyperloop (marked with ∗ ) successfully reduces latency but causes a clear drop in fidelity (FID degrades from 56.50 to 59.18) due to lack of boundary context. However, by incorporating our context-expanded mechanism , the full Latent Hyperloop not only resolves these artifacts but improves FID to 51.99 while reducing latency by about 28% relative to the baseline (16.37s → \to 11.83s). Subsequently, Sparse Patch-based Decoding provides additive efficiency gains by reducing redundancy in the decoding and sampling stages. Together, the two components reduce the total inference time to 8.04s – a 2 × \times acceleration compared to PixelRush (16.37s) – while improving visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么每个组件都很重要。图 A1 a 揭示了为什么这两个组件都是必需的。首先，我们观察到，Latent Hyperloop 的朴素实现（标有 ∗）虽然成功降低了延迟，但由于缺乏边界上下文，导致保真度明显下降（FID 从 56.50 恶化到 59.18）。然而，通过引入我们的上下文扩展机制，完整的 Latent Hyperloop 不仅解决了这些伪影问题，还将 FID 提升至 51.99，同时相对于基线将延迟降低了约 28%（16.37s \to 11.83s）。随后，基于稀疏补丁的解码通过减少解码和采样阶段的冗余，提供了额外的效率提升。两者结合，将总推理时间降至 8.04s——相比 PixelRush（16.37s）实现了 2 \times 加速——同时提升了视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: UltraFlash is developed and evaluated for cascade-based megapixel image synthesis. This focus allows us to isolate and optimize a concrete bottleneck that appears in practical high-resolution text-to-image pipelines: VAE-heavy transitions between latent and pixel space. We therefore view the method as a targeted acceleration strategy for image synthesis rather than a claim about all generative settings. Other modalities, such as video generation, introduce additional temporal and architectural considerations that are outside the scope of this work. At the same time, the central observation behind UltraFlash is broader: as denoising becomes faster, the surrounding transition costs become increasingly important. Exploring transition-aware acceleration beyond image cascades is a natural direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: UltraFlash 的开发与评估均针对基于级联的百万级像素图像合成。 这一聚焦使我们能够隔离并优化实际高分辨率文本到图像流水线中出现的一个具体瓶颈：潜空间与像素空间之间开销巨大的 VAE 转换。 因此，我们将该方法视为一种针对图像合成的定向加速策略，而非对所有生成场景的断言。 其他模态（如视频生成）会引入额外的时序与架构方面的考量，超出了本工作的范围。 与此同时，UltraFlash 背后的核心观察更具普遍性：随着去噪速度越来越快，周边转换的开销变得日益重要。 探索超越图像级联的转换感知加速是未来工作的一个自然方向。

paragraphs.en: UltraFlash improves the efficiency of high-resolution image synthesis by reducing transition overhead in cascade pipelines. This can make megapixel generation more practical for creative tools, design workflows, data visualization, and research settings where high-resolution outputs are useful but computational cost is a barrier. At the same time, faster and higher-resolution generation should be deployed with the same safeguards used for the underlying generative models, including content filtering, provenance or watermarking mechanisms when available, and responsible-use policies. UltraFlash does not introduce a new generative prior or bypass the safety behavior of the base models; it accelerates the transition operations around existing cascade refinement. We therefore view its impact as primarily improving efficiency, while inheriting the broader benefits and risks of the image-generation systems on which it is built.
paragraphs.zh: UltraFlash 通过减少级联流水线中的过渡开销，提高了高分辨率图像合成的效率。 这可以让百万像素级生成在创意工具、设计工作流、数据可视化以及研究场景中更加实用，这些场景需要高分辨率输出，但计算成本曾是障碍。 同时，更快、更高分辨率的生成应当部署时采用与底层生成模型相同的安全保障措施，包括内容过滤、可用的来源验证或水印机制，以及负责任使用政策。 UltraFlash 并未引入新的生成先验，也不会绕过基础模型的安全行为；它只是加速现有级联精炼过程中的过渡操作。 因此，我们认为其影响主要是提升效率，同时继承其构建所依托的图像生成系统更广泛的收益与风险。

sents.zh: 为了降低方差，所有定量比较均使用相同的提示词集合、指标、硬件和评估流程。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每个实验，论文是否提供了足够的信息来说明复现实验所需的计算机资源（计算工作节点的类型、内存、执行时间）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The experimental section reports that inference experiments are run on a single NVIDIA A100-40GB GPU and provides wall-clock runtime for each method. The paper also reports model size for Latent Hyperloop and the inference time needed to reproduce the main speed claims.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：实验部分报告推理实验在单块 NVIDIA A100-40GB GPU 上运行，并提供了每种方法的实际运行时间。 论文还报告了 Latent Hyperloop 的模型大小以及复现主要速度声明所需的推理时间。

sents.en: Justification: The experimental section reports that inference experiments are run on a single NVIDIA A100-40GB GPU and provides wall-clock runtime for each method.
sents.zh: 理由：实验部分报告推理实验在单块 NVIDIA A100-40GB GPU 上运行，并提供了每种方法的实际运行时间。

sents.en: The paper also reports model size for Latent Hyperloop and the inference time needed to reproduce the main speed claims.
sents.zh: 论文还报告了 Latent Hyperloop 的模型大小以及复现主要速度声明所需的推理时间。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中所进行的研究是否在各方面都符合 NeurIPS 道德准则 https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The work uses existing pretrained image-generation models and public datasets/prompts for research evaluation. We do not collect sensitive personal data or deploy the system, and we discuss potential misuse and broader impacts of improved high-resolution generation in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该工作使用现有的预训练图像生成模型以及公开数据集/提示词进行研究评估。 我们不收集敏感个人数据，也不部署该系统，并且我们在附录 E 中讨论了改进的高分辨率生成的潜在滥用问题及更广泛的影响。

sents.en: Justification: The work uses existing pretrained image-generation models and public datasets/prompts for research evaluation.
sents.zh: 理由：该工作使用现有的预训练图像生成模型以及公开数据集/提示词进行研究评估。

sents.en: We do not collect sensitive personal data or deploy the system, and we discuss potential misuse and broader impacts of improved high-resolution generation in Appendix E .
sents.zh: 我们不收集敏感个人数据，也不部署该系统，并且我们在附录 E 中讨论了改进的高分辨率生成的潜在滥用问题及更广泛的影响。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否讨论了所做工作可能带来的正面社会影响和负面社会影响？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper discusses broader impacts in Appendix E , including efficiency benefits for high-resolution image synthesis and the need to retain safeguards such as content filtering, provenance or watermarking mechanisms when available, and responsible-use policies inherited from the underlying generative models.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：论文在附录 E 中讨论了更广泛的影响，包括高分辨率图像合成的效率优势，以及在可用时保留内容过滤、来源验证或水印机制等保障措施，并沿用底层生成模型的责任使用政策的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了为负责任地发布具有较高滥用风险的数据或模型（例如预训练语言模型、图像生成器或抓取的数据集）而采取的保障措施？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The proposed modules are lightweight transition operators rather than standalone image generators. As discussed in Appendix E , UltraFlash does not introduce a new generative prior or bypass the safety behavior of the underlying generative models; it should be used with the same content filtering, provenance or watermarking mechanisms when available, and responsible-use policies as the base models. If released, the code and adapters will be distributed for research use with documentation, and no new scraped image dataset is released.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：所提出的模块是轻量级的过渡算子，而非独立的图像生成器。 如附录 E 所讨论，UltraFlash 未引入新的生成先验，也未绕过底层生成模型的安全行为；在可用时应配合与基础模型相同的内容过滤、来源追踪或水印机制以及负责任使用政策加以使用。 若予以发布，代码和适配器将附带文档以供研究用途分发，且不会发布任何新抓取的图像数据集。

sents.en: Justification: The proposed modules are lightweight transition operators rather than standalone image generators.
sents.zh: 理由：所提出的模块是轻量级的过渡算子，而非独立的图像生成器。

sents.en: As discussed in Appendix E , UltraFlash does not introduce a new generative prior or bypass the safety behavior of the underlying generative models; it should be used with the same content filtering, provenance or watermarking mechanisms when available, and responsible-use policies as the base models.
sents.zh: 如附录 E 所讨论，UltraFlash 未引入新的生成先验，也未绕过底层生成模型的安全行为；在可用时应配合与基础模型相同的内容过滤、来源追踪或水印机制以及负责任使用政策加以使用。

sents.en: If released, the code and adapters will be distributed for research use with documentation, and no new scraped image dataset is released.
sents.zh: 若予以发布，代码和适配器将附带文档以供研究用途分发，且不会发布任何新抓取的图像数据集。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中使用的资产（例如代码、数据、模型）的创作者或原始所有者是否得到了适当的署名，是否明确提及并正确遵守了许可证和使用条款？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper cites the pretrained models, datasets, and baseline methods used in the experiments, including SDXL, SDXL-Turbo, SD-Turbo, JourneyDB, LAION-Aesthetics, FouriScale, DemoFusion, FreeScale, and PixelRush. We use these assets according to their intended research/evaluation settings and provide references for attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：论文引用了实验中使用的预训练模型、数据集和基线方法，包括 SDXL、SDXL-Turbo、SD-Turbo、JourneyDB、LAION-Aesthetics、FouriScale、DemoFusion、FreeScale 和 PixelRush。 我们按照这些资产的预期研究/评估设置来使用它们，并提供参考文献以注明来源。

sents.en: Justification: The paper cites the pretrained models, datasets, and baseline methods used in the experiments, including SDXL, SDXL-Turbo, SD-Turbo, JourneyDB, LAION-Aesthetics, FouriScale, DemoFusion, FreeScale, and PixelRush.
sents.zh: 理由：论文引用了实验中使用的预训练模型、数据集和基线方法，包括 SDXL、SDXL-Turbo、SD-Turbo、JourneyDB、LAION-Aesthetics、FouriScale、DemoFusion、FreeScale 和 PixelRush。

sents.en: We use these assets according to their intended research/evaluation settings and provide references for attribution.
sents.zh: 我们按照这些资产的预期研究/评估设置来使用它们，并提供参考文献以注明来源。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中引入的新资产是否有完善的文档记录，并且文档是否随资产一并提供？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not introduce a new dataset or benchmark. The proposed Latent Hyperloop adapter and decoding procedure are documented in the method and supplemental material; if released, the trained adapters and code will include documentation and usage instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文没有引入新的数据集或基准。 所提出的潜在超环（Latent Hyperloop）适配器和解码流程已在方法部分和补充材料中作了说明；如果发布，训练好的适配器和代码将附带文档和使用说明。

sents.en: Justification: The paper does not introduce a new dataset or benchmark.
sents.zh: 理由：本文没有引入新的数据集或基准。

sents.en: The proposed Latent Hyperloop adapter and decoding procedure are documented in the method and supplemental material; if released, the trained adapters and code will include documentation and usage instructions.
sents.zh: 所提出的潜在超环（Latent Hyperloop）适配器和解码流程已在方法部分和补充材料中作了说明；如果发布，训练好的适配器和代码将附带文档和使用说明。

paragraphs.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 众包与人类受试者研究

paragraphs.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于众包实验及涉及人类受试者的研究，论文是否包含了提供给参与者的指导说明的完整文本和截图（如适用），以及报酬细节（如有）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The user preference study was an unpaid, voluntary perceptual evaluation. Participants were presented with side-by-side generated images and asked to select the one with better overall quality, text alignment, and structure. Because no commercial crowdsourcing platform was used and no financial compensation was provided, platform and compensation details are not applicable; the current submission does not include full interface screenshots.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：用户偏好研究是一项无报酬、自愿参与的感知评估。 参与者会看到并排生成的图像，并被要求选择在整体质量、文本对齐和结构方面更好的一张。 由于没有使用商业众包平台，也未提供任何经济补偿，平台和补偿细节不适用；当前提交的版本未包含完整的界面截图。

sents.en: Justification: The user preference study was an unpaid, voluntary perceptual evaluation.
sents.zh: 理由：用户偏好研究是一项无报酬、自愿参与的感知评估。

sents.en: Participants were presented with side-by-side generated images and asked to select the one with better overall quality, text alignment, and structure.

sents.en: Because no commercial crowdsourcing platform was used and no financial compensation was provided, platform and compensation details are not applicable; the current submission does not include full interface screenshots.

paragraphs.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 涉及人类受试者研究的机构审查委员会（IRB）批准或同等许可

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了研究参与者可能承担的潜在风险、此类风险是否已向受试者披露，以及是否获得了机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或基于您所在国家或机构要求的等效批准/审查）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The user study is a low-risk anonymous preference evaluation of generated images, but the current submission does not describe IRB or equivalent review. We will add details on participant risk, consent, anonymity, and institutional requirements in the supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 说明：用户研究是一项针对生成图像的低风险匿名偏好评估，但当前投稿未说明是否经过IRB或同等审查。 我们将在补充材料中加入关于受试者风险、知情同意、匿名性以及机构要求的具体说明。

sents.en: Justification: The user study is a low-risk anonymous preference evaluation of generated images, but the current submission does not describe IRB or equivalent review.
sents.zh: 说明：用户研究是一项针对生成图像的低风险匿名偏好评估，但当前投稿未说明是否经过IRB或同等审查。

sents.en: We will add details on participant risk, consent, anonymity, and institutional requirements in the supplemental material.
sents.zh: 我们将在补充材料中加入关于受试者风险、知情同意、匿名性以及机构要求的具体说明。

Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：如果大语言模型是本研究核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了智能体的使用情况？ 请注意，如果智能体仅用于写作、编辑或排版目的，且不影响研究核心方法、科学严谨性或原创性，则无需声明。
